description: ComfyUI custom-node pack with a card-grid picker for images and VHS path loaders

phases.name: v0.1.0 — Initial Release
phases.description: GalleryLoadImage node, modal over LoadImage, VHS path integration

features.title: GalleryLoadImage node with inline card grid
features.description: Drop-in LoadImage replacement with the picker rendered inline on the node body. Cards scroll independently of the canvas.

features.title: Modal picker over stock LoadImage
features.description: Intercept the `image` combo widget on LoadImage, LoadImageMask, LoadImageOutput. Source tabs for Input / Output / Temp; commits annotated values.

features.title: VHS path-loader integration
features.description: Detect nodes whose STRING widget has vhs_path_extensions. Add 📁 Browse button opening path-mode modal at base_path. Commit raw absolute paths.

features.title: fzf-lite fuzzy filter
features.description: Picker rows filtered by the filter input via fuzzy subsequence matching with separator/CamelCase bonuses and AND-token semantics.

features.title: HTTP listing + thumbnail + file streaming endpoints
features.description: /gallery_loader/{list, base, thumb, file} powering the picker UI. Extension whitelist guards arbitrary-path reads.

features.title: Value-format contract per source
features.description: Input commits bare relative; Output/Temp commit annotated; VHS commits raw absolute. Resolved by folder_paths.get_annotated_filepath or raw open.

features.title: Touch-friendly modal UX
features.description: Backdrop dismiss wired to pointerdown not click; touch-action: manipulation suppresses iOS double-tap zoom. Cards sized for thumb-reachability.

features.title: Frontend Hook Strategy A + B
features.description: Strategy A: widget.onPointerDown patch (needs comfyui-frontend-package>=1.40). Strategy B: explicit 📁 Browse button (always works). B is the version-skew safety net.

features.title: Static asset serving
features.description: Pack served via WEB_DIRECTORY="./web". Pack directory name comfyui-gallery-loader/ is part of the served URL prefix.
